d: Deep plum purple hair is styled with long side-swept bangs and a voluminous ponytail, featuring small white star-shaped clips. The eyes are heterochromatic, with the right eye being a vivid ruby red and the left eye a bright sapphire blue, both wide and cheerful. The face is youthful and adolescent, paired with a slender build. The outfit consists of a light blue strapless bikini top with white piping, a white translucent shrug, and a blue sun visor with pink star accents. Signature details include a small beige guinea pig perched on the shoulder and a gold heart pendant necklace.
